organizations.name: National Fair Housing Alliance
organizations.what_they_help_with: Network of local fair housing centers that investigate discrimination (including undercover testing) and help you file complaints free.

organizations.name: HUD Office of Fair Housing and Equal Opportunity
organizations.what_they_help_with: Federal housing discrimination complaints (1-year deadline). Investigates landlords, lenders, and agents at no cost to you.

organizations.name: National Low Income Housing Coalition
organizations.eligibility: Anyone; strongest as a policy/resource hub
organizations.what_they_help_with: State-by-state guides to rental assistance, eviction protections, and tenant rights; connects to state housing coalitions.
